title: Choose the workspace visual world
question: Keep Evidence Light Table, choose a challenger, re-roll, or take the familiar category standard.

options.label: Evidence Light Table
options.lineage: drawing-office light tables, translucent revision overlays, and grease-pencil review marks
options.thesis: The drawing is the workspace; member data and ambiguity controls attach directly to its evidence.
options.viewport: A dominant illuminated evidence plane, a narrow indexed member register, and one decision strip docked beneath the selected member.
options.risk: Paper texture or spatial controls could become skeuomorphic if they compete with drawing legibility.

options.label: Decision Wayfinding
options.lineage: international airport sign systems and chained decision points
options.thesis: Every unresolved member becomes one unmistakable next junction through the review set.
options.case: Very clear sequencing, but less immediately native to quantity-surveying practice than the light table.
options.viewport: Drawing evidence owns the left field while a monumental member ID and yellow next-decision band lead the right edge.
options.risk: Monumental signs can oversimplify dense comparison and editing tasks.

options.label: Surveyor’s Instrument
options.lineage: creator-hardware desk instruments with tactile keys, detents, and one commit control
options.thesis: A repeat-use expert tool whose controls feel learned, certain, and fast under the hand.
options.case: Excellent for daily speed, but the dense control chassis risks becoming the complex UI you rejected.
options.viewport: A large drawing bed is surrounded by discrete tool keys, a compact member table, and one orange commit action.
options.risk: Too many persistent controls can make the interface feel like specialist hardware before it feels simple.

options.label: Evidence Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscopes, triggered traces, graticules, and measurement cursors
options.thesis: Selecting a member locks noisy drawing evidence into one measured, inspectable signal.
options.case: The evidence mechanism translates well, but the dark instrument language has the weakest audience identification.
options.viewport: A gridded drawing field carries the selected member, evidence cursors, member index, and a compact resolve control.
options.risk: Signal density and near-black glass can read as diagnostic software and increase perceived complexity.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A conventional PDF viewer, AI chat, and editable data table in three panes.
canonCard.viewport: Three familiar columns place the PDF, assistant, and extracted data side by side.
canonCard.risk: Immediately familiar, but likely to become the visually complex workspace you want to avoid.
